title: Add a clamp function with tests

brief.goal: Add `clamp(n, min, max)` to src/math.ts that limits n to [min, max] and throws a RangeError when min > max, with a unit test file test/clamp.test.ts.
constraints: Change only the files named in the goal; no new dependencies
Keep TypeScript strict; relative imports use explicit .ts extensions
Tests use node:test and node:assert/strict and run with node --experimental-strip-types --test
acceptanceCriteria: src/math.ts exports `clamp(n: number, min: number, max: number): number`
clamp returns min when n < min, max when n > max, and n otherwise
clamp throws RangeError when min > max
test/clamp.test.ts exists and passes with `node --experimental-strip-types --test test/clamp.test.ts`
the existing `add` export and its test keep passing

expected_clean_output: clamp added to src/math.ts with a RangeError guard; test/clamp.test.ts added; both test files pass.

seeded_defect.description: clamp swaps the bounds: it returns max when n is below min and min when n is above max.
seeded_defect.how_to_detect: Run the grader: clamp(5, 0, 3) returns 0 instead of 3.
